findings.issue: לְטַפֵּנוּ is a collective singular (little ones) with a 1cp suffix; «nuestro niño» narrows it to one child.
The lamed marks the beneficiary (for the livestock / for the little ones). Spanish «a» can be read as the direct object of edificar.
findings.spanishSpan: a nuestro ganado … a nuestro niño

notes: Approach, speech, sheep-enclosures, build, here, and cities match the tokens.
